parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE pocketsound_creators (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

  user_id BIGINT UNIQUE
    REFERENCES pocketsound_users(id)
    ON DELETE CASCADE,

  bio TEXT,
  verified BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,

  total_views INT DEFAULT 0,
  total_files INT DEFAULT 0,

  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_ads (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

  advertiser_user_id BIGINT
    REFERENCES pocketsound_users(id)
    ON DELETE CASCADE,

  ad_type VARCHAR(32),
  target_category VARCHAR(64),

  budget NUMERIC(12, 4),
  spent NUMERIC(12, 4) DEFAULT 0,

  starts_at TIMESTAMP,
  ends_at TIMESTAMP,

  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_transactions (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

  user_id BIGINT
    REFERENCES pocketsound_users(id)
    ON DELETE CASCADE,

  tx_type VARCHAR(32),
  amount NUMERIC(12, 4),

  metadata JSONB,

  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_streams (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

  creator_id BIGINT
    REFERENCES pocketsound_creators(id)
    ON DELETE CASCADE,

  tg_chat_id BIGINT,
  message_id INT,

  is_live BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  duration INT,

  viewers INT DEFAULT 0,
  saved_to_profile BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,

  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);
ALTER TABLE pocketsound_users ALTER COLUMN tg_id DROP NOT NULL;

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE pocketsound_users (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

  tg_id BIGINT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  tg_username VARCHAR(64),
  tg_first_name VARCHAR(128),
  tg_last_name VARCHAR(128),
  photo_url TEXT,

  premium BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  language_code VARCHAR(8),

  balance_stars NUMERIC(12, 4) DEFAULT 0,
  balance_wallet NUMERIC(12, 4) DEFAULT 0,

  user_role VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'user',
  is_bot BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,

  last_active_at TIMESTAMP,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_pocketsound_users_tg_id
  ON pocketsound_users (tg_id);

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_tg_chats (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

  tg_chat_id BIGINT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  chat_type VARCHAR(32),
  title VARCHAR(255),
  username VARCHAR(64),

  is_public BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  is_indexable BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,

  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_files (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

  owner_user_id BIGINT
    REFERENCES pocketsound_users(id)
    ON DELETE SET NULL,

  tg_chat_id BIGINT
    REFERENCES pocketsound_tg_chats(tg_chat_id)
    ON DELETE CASCADE,

  message_id INT NOT NULL,

  file_unique_id VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE,
  file_type VARCHAR(32),
  mime_type VARCHAR(128),

  title VARCHAR(255),
  artist VARCHAR(255),
  album VARCHAR(255),
  file_name VARCHAR(255),

  duration INT,
  file_size BIGINT,

  is_public BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
  is_searchable BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,

  uploaded_at TIMESTAMP,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_pocketsound_files_message
  ON pocketsound_files (tg_chat_id, message_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_pocketsound_files_searchable
  ON pocketsound_files (is_searchable);

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_file_search_index (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

  file_id BIGINT
    REFERENCES pocketsound_files(id)
    ON DELETE CASCADE,

  search_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  normalized_text TEXT NOT NULL,

  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_pocketsound_search_normalized
  ON pocketsound_file_search_index
  USING GIN (to_tsvector('simple', normalized_text));

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_search_queries (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

  user_id BIGINT
    REFERENCES pocketsound_users(id)
    ON DELETE CASCADE,

  query_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  results_count INT,

  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_file_shares (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

  file_id BIGINT
    REFERENCES pocketsound_files(id)
    ON DELETE CASCADE,

  from_user_id BIGINT
    REFERENCES pocketsound_users(id),

  to_user_id BIGINT
    REFERENCES pocketsound_users(id),

  share_type VARCHAR(32),

  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_stories (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

  creator_id BIGINT
    REFERENCES pocketsound_creators(id)
    ON DELETE CASCADE,

  tg_chat_id BIGINT,
  message_id INT,

  story_type VARCHAR(32),
  category VARCHAR(64),

  views INT DEFAULT 0,
  expires_at TIMESTAMP,

  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_ad_stories (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

  ad_id BIGINT
    REFERENCES pocketsound_ads(id)
    ON DELETE CASCADE,

  story_id BIGINT
    REFERENCES pocketsound_stories(id)
    ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_playlists (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  
  user_id BIGINT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES pocketsound_users(id)
    ON DELETE CASCADE,
  
  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  
  is_public BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Индекс для поиска плейлистов пользователя
CREATE INDEX idx_playlists_user_id 
  ON pocketsound_playlists(user_id);

-- Индекс для публичных плейлистов
CREATE INDEX idx_playlists_public 
  ON pocketsound_playlists(is_public) 
  WHERE is_public = TRUE;

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_playlist_tracks (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  
  playlist_id BIGINT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES pocketsound_playlists(id)
    ON DELETE CASCADE,
  
  file_id BIGINT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES pocketsound_files(id)
    ON DELETE CASCADE,
  
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  added_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
  
  -- Один файл = один раз в плейлисте
  UNIQUE(playlist_id, file_id)
);

-- Индекс для выборки треков плейлиста
CREATE INDEX idx_playlist_tracks_playlist 
  ON pocketsound_playlist_tracks(playlist_id);

-- Индекс для сортировки по позиции
CREATE INDEX idx_playlist_tracks_position 
  ON pocketsound_playlist_tracks(playlist_id, position);

-- Индекс для поиска "в каких плейлистах этот файл"
CREATE INDEX idx_playlist_tracks_file 
  ON pocketsound_playlist_tracks(file_id);

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_user_limits (
  user_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY
    REFERENCES pocketsound_users(id)
    ON DELETE CASCADE,
  
  max_playlists INTEGER DEFAULT 3,
  extra_playlists_purchased INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  
  max_tracks_per_playlist INTEGER DEFAULT 33,
  extra_slots_purchased INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Индекс для быстрой проверки лимитов
CREATE INDEX idx_user_limits_user_id 
  ON pocketsound_user_limits(user_id);

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_user_states (
  user_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY
    REFERENCES pocketsound_users(id)
    ON DELETE CASCADE,
  
  current_state VARCHAR(64),
  state_data JSONB,
  state_started_at TIMESTAMP,
  
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_user_states_user_id 
  ON pocketsound_user_states(user_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_user_states_state 
  ON pocketsound_user_states(current_state);

CREATE INDEX idx_user_states_active 
  ON pocketsound_user_states(user_id, current_state)
  WHERE current_state IS NOT NULL;

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_credentials (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES pocketsound_users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    login VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    password_hash VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
    last_login TIMESTAMP,
    login_attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    is_locked BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    password_changed_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_auth_codes (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES pocketsound_users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    code_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,  -- 'confirmation', 'reset'
    code VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    is_used BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    used_at TIMESTAMP,
    ip_address INET,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_sessions (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES pocketsound_users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    refresh_token VARCHAR(512) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    ip_address INET,
    user_agent TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

ALTER TABLE pocketsound_users 
ADD COLUMN email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE,
ADD COLUMN phone VARCHAR(20),
ADD COLUMN is_email_confirmed BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE;

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_playlist_deezer_tracks (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    playlist_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    deezer_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    added_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
    CONSTRAINT fk_playlist_deezer_playlist
        FOREIGN KEY (playlist_id)
        REFERENCES pocketsound_playlists(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,
    UNIQUE(playlist_id, deezer_id)
);

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_user_likes (
    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    deezer_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    liked_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, deezer_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_user_likes_user
        FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES pocketsound_users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_user_history (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    deezer_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    listened_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
    CONSTRAINT fk_user_history_user
        FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES pocketsound_users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- Индексы для производительности
CREATE INDEX idx_playlist_deezer_tracks_playlist_id
    ON pocketsound_playlist_deezer_tracks(playlist_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_playlist_deezer_tracks_deezer_id
    ON pocketsound_playlist_deezer_tracks(deezer_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_user_likes_user_id
    ON pocketsound_user_likes(user_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_user_likes_deezer_id
    ON pocketsound_user_likes(deezer_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_user_history_user_id
    ON pocketsound_user_history(user_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_user_history_deezer_id
    ON pocketsound_user_history(deezer_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_user_history_listened_at
    ON pocketsound_user_history(listened_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE pocketsound_download_queue (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  
  user_id BIGINT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES pocketsound_users(id)
    ON DELETE CASCADE,
  
  chat_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  track_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  stream_url TEXT NOT NULL,
  output_path VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  support_topic_id BIGINT,
  
  status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending',
  -- pending → processing → done / failed
  
  error_message TEXT,
  
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
  started_at TIMESTAMP,
  finished_at TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE INDEX idx_download_queue_status
  ON pocketsound_download_queue(status);

CREATE INDEX idx_download_queue_user
  ON pocketsound_download_queue(user_id);
